snippet.title: Spore Hero For The Wii  Make Yourself A Hero Trailer
snippet.description:
Spore finally comes to the Wii in this all-new adventure.  Create your own creature hero and fight to save your planet from a dangerous threat.  Earn unique new parts to adapt your hero for courageous battles and amazing adventures. 
www.sporehero.com
